notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 13, 18, 23, 26
and 27. These questions covered different parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
There were only two questions that were answered correctly by 45 per cent or fewer of the candidates.
These were Questions 4 and 28.
